'''Gally Arc''' was a flamboyant collector of antique [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. He once contracted a group of individuals to accompany him to [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] to collect a staff [[Transport/Legends|transport]] that was previously owned by a famous [[Esselian]] [[General/Legends|general]].<ref name="Into the Core Worlds" />
